instincts.symptom: Android VPN yeniden baslatmada SOCKS5 127.0.0.1:10808 Address already in use (os error 98) ve One UI ana ekranda kesik beyaz koseli ikon
instincts.cause: Yeni LanProxy baslatilmadan once eski proxy JoinHandle'i beklenmiyor ve Adaptive Icon foreground 108dp tuvalde %61 safe zone disina tasiyor
instincts.reflex: Android'de yeni proxy baslatmadan once stop_and_wait() + port fallback (10808..10828) uygula; Adaptive Icon foreground icerigini %54 safe zone icinde ve #070B12 arka planla uret
